description: This Java class implements product image management functionalities such as adding, retrieving, and removing product images, including image resizing and cropping based on configuration settings.

classes.name: ProductFileManagerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of product file management, including image upload, retrieval, cropping, resizing, and deletion.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Handles adding a product image, including processing, resizing, cropping, and uploading multiple image sizes based on configuration.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the product image output content, either original or resized.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product images for a given merchant store or product.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a given product.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes all images for a given merchant store.
